description: The job ends and the cover ends. The gap is bridged at personal cost or not at all.
energy_note: Unemployed and uninsured on the same afternoon.

aspect: It removes the option of leaving
description: An employee with a chronic condition, a pregnancy or a dependent in treatment cannot weigh a job move purely on the job.
energy_note: Held in place by a medical need, not a contract.

description: The work is bad and the manager is worse. His daughter's medication is covered under the plan. He stays fourteen more months and stops mentioning it at home.
